claim: RmlUi 6.3's Lua bindings do not compile against Lua 5.1: they call luaL_setfuncs, lua_tointegerx, luaL_testudata, luaL_traceback and LUA_OK, which its own 5.1 shim (Include/RmlUi/Lua/Utilities.h) does not provide; viewer/core/src/lua51_compat.h supplies them force-included, RmlUi unpatched
notes: build logs 20261031_j31 (first two Docker builds failed on these names; Empire built with Lua bindings off, so it never met this)
